title: Tiny, cute violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcf7a' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcf7a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='30' rx='3' fill='#c98a3c'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='14' width='2' height='30' fill='#e8b86a'/>
  <!-- pegbox -->
  <rect x='43' y='6' width='14' height='11' rx='3' fill='#b5732c'/>
  <rect x='43' y='6' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d9984a'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='10' r='1.6' fill='#ffdca0'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#ffdca0'/>
  <circle cx='54.5' cy='10' r='1.6' fill='#ffdca0'/>
  <circle cx='54.5' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#ffdca0'/>
  <!-- scroll -->
  <path d='M50 5 C50 1 57 1 57 5 C57 8 52 8 52 6' fill='none' stroke='#e8b86a' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='48' y1='16' x2='48' y2='72' stroke='#fff4d6' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#fff4d6' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='16' x2='52' y2='72' stroke='#fff4d6' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#d9984a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='13' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#f2c07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- waist -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#c98a3c'/>
  <!-- lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#d9984a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='17' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#f2c07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- f-holes -->
  <path d='M43 52 C41 58 43 64 42 68' fill='none' stroke='#7a4a14' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 52 C59 58 57 64 58 68' fill='none' stroke='#7a4a14' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='52' r='1.3' fill='#7a4a14'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='52' r='1.3' fill='#7a4a14'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='68' r='1.3' fill='#7a4a14'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='1.3' fill='#7a4a14'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='45' y='61' width='10' height='2.4' rx='1' fill='#ffdca0'/>
  <!-- tailpiece -->
  <path d='M47 68 L53 68 L51.5 79 L48.5 79 Z' fill='#7a4a14'/>
  <!-- chinrest-ish little smile -->
  <path d='M46 82 Q50 85 54 82' fill='none' stroke='#ffdca0' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bow -->
  <line x1='18' y1='30' x2='30' y2='92' stroke='#a86e2a' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='20.5' y1='32' x2='32' y2='91' stroke='#fff4d6' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
